footer.disclaimer:
Inspired by the Relationship Anarchy Smorgasbord; built with D3, based on their Sunburst diagram.
No cookies, no tracking, no data collected. Local storage used to make sure you don't have to start over every time you load the website.

faq.whats_this_content: This is a tool to help you discuss and explore which practices are welcome in your dynamic. It's inspired by the Relationship Anarchy Smorgasbord, originally developed by Lyrica Lawrence and Heather Orr in 2016 — here, re-flavoured for consent.
faq.how_to_use_content_1: Set the people this board is for at the top of the page. Then click on a field: each click cycles a practice from Not Defined through Hard Limit, Soft Limit, Can and Should to Must — and updates its parents and children accordingly. Right-click any field to add context or notes.
faq.how_to_use_content_2: Exactly how you use this tool is up to you, but it works best when you fill it in together. You can either click through it together, or each use it independently and share your results with each other. The point is to have a conversation.
faq.safety_content: Smorkinkboard is a consent tool, not a script: it shows which practices are welcome for the people in a dynamic, and which aren't. It only works if you fill it in together after actually talking about it — and if you keep revisiting it, because limits and favourites change over time. When in doubt, ask.
